An enemy who is crouching, lying on the floor, flinching from a hit, or in his smoke ball form cannot be caught, and then BLUE is the normal BITE. Lighter fighters, like the Cat, fly further when they are thrown. It is not in Wi-Fi fights yet, because Verity's BLUE moves are still waiting for their turn there.

t: WI-FI ROOMS: EVERY FIGHTER, AND A FASTER LINK
n: Wi-Fi rooms now work with all five fighters of Versus: Gojo, Yuji, Verity, the Cartoon Cat and Freddy Krueger. On the choose screen tap one of the five cards (tap it again to change your mind). When both of you have chosen, the game shows who fights who, and when you both tap FIGHT it starts. If you both choose the same fighter, the dice roll who gets the inverted one, like before.

Every fighter's basic moves work online, between any two fighters: walking, jumping, crouching, dashing, blocking (and parrying), the ATTACK combos, the crouch attacks, Verity's teleport, the Cat's grab combo (his glove pulls the other player in) and Freddy's catch (his hand holds whoever swung for 0.75 seconds). Everything is unlocked in a Wi-Fi fight, so nothing has to be bought first. Yuji has no INHERITENCE.

What is not online yet, and comes in the next updates: the BLUE moves (only Gojo's teleport in the air works), the MODE button, DOMAIN, FATAL, the heavy strike, the Cat's arm hang and Freddy's pierce. Those buttons are dimmed in a Wi-Fi fight.

A much faster link between the two phones. Every message now travels on two roads at once, the old reliable one and a fast one, and the game uses whichever copy arrives first. On a busy Wi-Fi a lost packet can hold everything back for a second or more, which is the most likely reason the ping was around 700 ms; now a lost packet usually costs well under a tenth of a second. The app also asks the phone to keep its Wi-Fi radio awake while you play, because the radio dozing between small packets slows every answer down.

The ping is shown on the choose screen and at the bottom of the fight (PING 14). It is measured on the fast road. If the router blocks the fast road, the game keeps working on the old one and the choose screen says SLOW ROAD.
Both phones need this version. If the other phone has another version of the game, the choose screen says so and the cards do nothing until you both update.

t: THE CAT: ARM HANG AND GROUND POUND
n: A new move for the Cartoon Cat: the ARM HANG. Jump, then press ATTACK while you are in the air (10 energy, $400 in the shop, needs FLATTEN). The ATTACK button says HANG in the air.
His arms stretch up off the top of the screen and he hangs from them for up to 5 seconds, out of everybody's reach: the enemy's swings, grabs and finishers cannot touch him up there.
While he hangs you can still move: push left and right and he walks along his arms, hand over hand, at his normal walking speed (a little slower going back). He can walk right over the enemy.

Crouch (the S key, or push the stick down) and he lets go and smashes down like a hammer, the GROUND POUND. An enemy under him or next to him (up to about 36 pixels away on either side) takes 35 damage, is knocked down and is shoved away from him, and a shock wave runs out along the floor. The pound itself costs no energy. An enemy who is guarding blocks it, as with his other blows.
If you do nothing, after 5 seconds he lets go and falls to the floor, with no damage. If something gets through to him while he hangs, he falls too.
The hint DOWN: SMASH shows under his feet for the first seconds of every hang.

The pictures (the arms shooting up, hanging, walking hand over hand, and the dive and the squash of the pound) are new, drawn with the Cat's own body rig, so they match the rest of him. On a taller screen the arms simply run up to the top of it.

t: THE CAT: GIANT KICK AND GIANT LIFT
n: Two more BLUE moves for the Cartoon Cat, depending on what he is doing when you press BLUE.

GIANT KICK (flat on the floor, then BLUE, 20 energy, $250 in the shop): the old giant kick is back. The huge Cat pops up behind you and kicks the enemy away for 25 damage, with about 100 pixels of reach. You stay flat on the floor while he does it. If the enemy is too far away it says MISS.
GIANT SMASH has moved a little: flat on the floor, hold BACK and press BLUE. (If you only own GIANT SMASH and not the kick, plain BLUE still does it, like before.)

GIANT LIFT (jump, then BLUE in the air, 5 energy, $350 in the shop): the huge Cat catches you in mid-air and holds you up high, out of the top of the screen, for about a second, then puts you down again where you were. It does no damage. Nothing can touch you while you are in his glove, so it is a quick breather.
The BLUE button changes its name: CARTOON TOSS standing, GIANT LIFT in the air, GIANT KICK when flat, and GIANT SMASH when flat and holding back.

Both are new skills on the CAT tab of the SKILLS page. Both need CARTOON ATTACK, and the kick needs FLATTEN as well. They use the pictures the game already had (the giant's grab, the Cat in his glove and the old kick), so there is no new art.
Two more BLUE moves for Sukuna, depending on where he is when you press BLUE.

LEG CUT (crouch, then BLUE, 10 energy): a low sweep of his hand and an invisible slash cuts the enemy's legs at once, wherever he stands on the screen. The enemy drops to his knees and is stunned for 0.8 seconds, and while he kneels every hit lands on him (he cannot duck, block or dodge). The cut also makes him bleed.

DISMANTLE (jump, then BLUE in the air, 20 energy): Sukuna dashes back in the air, points one finger at the enemy and says "DISMANTLE". Everything freezes for about a second and a half (the screen goes grey with red bars, a line shows where he is aiming, and the word appears in big letters with a deep sound).

Then time starts again and the enemy is cut 3 times in the chest, one cut after the other. Nothing can block or dodge these cuts. Each cut makes him bleed for 8 seconds, and the bleeds stack, so he bleeds out (about 80 health in all). He is stunned until a moment after the last cut, and nothing can hurt Sukuna while he does it.

DISMANTLE needs an enemy on the screen in front of Sukuna. If there is none, it says NO TARGET and costs nothing. The BLUE button changes its name: AIR CUT standing, CUT STORM holding back, LEG CUT crouching, and DISMAN-TLE in the air.
The enemy has a kneeling picture for each fighter: Gojo and Yuji crouch, Verity folds up, and the Cartoon Cat goes dizzy.
The two new animations (the low sweep, and the dash with the pointing finger) are made with Yuji's body rig, like the other Sukuna moves.

Sukuna has a BLUE button move now. The BLUE button reads AIR CUT: Sukuna flicks his hand and an invisible slash cuts the enemy at once, wherever he stands on the screen. You never see it fly, only the cut across the enemy.

The AIR CUT costs 5 energy. The enemy flinches a little, takes no health from the cut itself, and starts to bleed (0.1 health every 0.03 seconds for 4 seconds, about 13 health in all). A guard blocks it, and an enemy who is crouching, dodging or lying down is not hit.
Hold BACK and press BLUE for the CUT STORM: Sukuna raises his hand forward with the fingers spread and throws 8 invisible slashes one after the other. It costs 25 energy.
Every slash of the CUT STORM cuts the enemy, and the enemy is stunned for 3 seconds after the last one, so he cannot fight back.

The bleeds stack: every slash that lands adds its own bleed, so 8 slashes make the enemy bleed 8 times as fast (about 106 health in all). The counter's slash adds a bleed too, and a new bleed no longer restarts the old one.
In free play your energy is infinite until you set YOUR ENERGY to NORMAL in the free-play settings. BLUE only works while Sukuna is standing on the ground.
The two new animations (the quick flick and the hand with spread fingers) are made with Yuji's body rig, like the slashes before them.

Sukuna can attack while crouched now: crouch and press ATTACK for a right jab, then an uppercut with the left hand, one after the other. They are Yuji's own crouch punches (10 and 13 damage) and they can hit an enemy that is crouching too.

New: if you press ATTACK and there is no enemy close in front of Sukuna (nobody within about 60 pixels), he does not punch, he THROWS A SLASH instead: a red and white slash that flies forward for 0.6 seconds, cannot be blocked and takes 6 health.
The first press throws a slash with the right hand, the next one with the left hand. A single slash only flies a quarter of the screen, so it will not reach an enemy that stands far away.

The third press is the X SLASH: both hands at once, two slashes that cross like an X and fly all the way to the edge of the screen. Each of the two takes 12 health (24 if both hit). It cannot be blocked either.

The X SLASH can only be thrown once every 5 seconds. Until it is ready, the third press is just another single slash (right, left, right, left...), and when the 5 seconds are over the next press is the X again. If you wait more than 0.7 seconds between presses, the chain starts again with the right hand.
An enemy right in front of him still gets the old combo (jab, jab, kick, counter). The slashes do not make the enemy bleed, and an enemy who is crouching, dodging or lying down is not hit by them.
The crouch punches are Yuji's own pictures with Sukuna's head; the two new slash animations are made with Yuji's body rig, like the first slash.
Sukuna can fight now. Press ATTACK: a right jab, then a left jab, then a kick to the face, then the fourth one: the COUNTER. Keep pressing and the four go round again.
The kick to the face is a little jump with a high kick, aimed at the enemy's head.

The counter is different: Sukuna just stands still (so it does not look like he is going to attack). If the enemy swings at him in the next 2 seconds, he dodges it with a quick step back, steps in and slashes the enemy.
The slash does no damage by itself, it makes the enemy bleed for 4 seconds: 0.1 health every 0.03 seconds (about 13 health in all), with drops of blood running off him.
A press of ATTACK while a punch is still going is kept for a moment and starts the next one, so the combo flows. If nobody attacks during the counter, he just relaxes after 2 seconds.
The jabs are Yuji's own punch animation with Sukuna's head; the kick, the dodge and the slash are made the same way.
Sukuna can walk now: left and right, at Yuji's speed forward and slower backwards, with Yuji's walking animation (played backwards for walking back).
Sukuna can jump: the same push-off, flight and landing as Yuji, the same height and dust, and you can steer him in the air.
Sukuna can crouch: tap crouch to go down with Yuji's crouch animation, crouch-walk at the slower crouching speed, and tap again to stand up.
It is all Yuji's own animation with Sukuna's head and collar on it, so he stands and moves exactly where Yuji does, and he blinks in the crouch too.
He still cannot dash, block or attack, and he cannot jump out of a crouch yet. Characters you draw yourself in CUSTOM work exactly as before.
Sukuna is now a playable fighter. Open FREE PLAY and pick the new SUKUNA card, after Freddy.
For now he can only stand there: he breathes, sways and blinks like Yuji, but he cannot walk, jump, crouch, dash, block or attack yet. Whatever you press, he stays put.
The enemy can still fight back (SET > GAME): Sukuna is pushed back and flashes white when he is hit, and when his health runs out the round starts again. He has no knock-out pictures yet.

He is made from Yuji's own pictures with a new head (tall swept-up pink hair, a narrow eye, the black marks on his face, a rolled red collar, dark nails), so he stands exactly where Yuji stands. His energy bar is crimson.
The fighter screen now has room for six cards, also on a narrower screen.
Chapter 2's TO BE CONTINUED card now goes on: tap it and chapter 3 starts. A save that has finished chapter 2 starts at chapter 3.
Chapter 3 opens in the cold hall under a golden wheel. Verity lies on the floor. Mahoraga's eyes light up and he walks up to him, his heavy steps shaking the floor and kicking up dust.
Verity raises a hand and uses STOP: a violet bolt freezes Mahoraga in mid-step, the golden wheel above his head turns one notch (he adapts), the ring breaks and he walks on.

Then he stops over Verity, winds his fist up, and punches Verity on the floor: the picture flashes and inverts, Verity folds around the fist and is broken in half, and the two halves fly back along the floor in a spray of blood.

Mahoraga is all new: 92 hand-made pictures (idle, a smooth 32-picture walk, wind-up, punch with motion streaks, recover), shaded like a sculpture, with cloth that swings, planted feet and a faint shadow and reflection on the floor.
The new part is about 25 seconds long. Tapping skips from shot to shot, and there are 17 new sounds.

After MAHORAGA, Verity charges at Megumi through a rush of speed lines. A huge white being wrapped in tight white cloth tears itself together behind Megumi: strips of cloth snap in from the sides, a golden wheel and four glowing eyes light up, and the picture cuts in close on its face.
After the Master crushes Gojo's eye, the claw opens and a violet circle takes the blue stone away.
The stone arrives in space, where "???" stands on a dark planet under a big ringed world. His hand takes it and puts it in the thumb of his gauntlet, and the blue light runs over the gold.

The stone flares with bolts of blue light, he lifts the gauntlet and a pillar of light stands up from it. Then you see the whole planet from space: cracks of light run over it and it bursts into pieces. Then chapter 2 ends.
Most of the care went into "???": his scenes are lit only by the blue stone, and the light moves over him, his hand and the gauntlet as the stone moves.
The new part is about 36 seconds long. Tapping still skips from shot to shot. There are 18 new sounds.
Chapter 2 goes on after Verity says WASTED POTENTIAL: a voice in the dark says "DID SOMEONE SAY...", then "POTENTIAL?", and a cold light comes in.
Megumi stands in that light, seen from below with a rim of light all around him. He is the new picture from your drawing, shown in big pixels.

He calls out his summoning in four steps, each one with its own close-up, light and sound: "WITH THIS SACRED TREASURE, I SUMMON...", EIGHT-HANDLED SWORD (a blade of light is drawn from his fists), DIVERGENT SILA DIVINE GENERAL (a golden wheel opens behind his head) and MAHORAGA (the wheel and the name flash up, the picture shakes).
The scene is about 16 seconds long, then it goes on to the Master's room as before. Tapping skips from shot to shot like the rest of the ending.
Megumi has his own calm voice for the speech box.
Getting into the portal in chapter 2 is now really hard. The street is more than twice as long, and every STOP hits much harder and pushes you back further.

His STOP comes in four kinds, and the colour of the ring on the floor tells you which one: purple (block it, duck or jump), red (nothing blocks it), teal (a low sweep, ducking does not help) and orange (nothing blocks it and ducking does not help, only a well timed jump or dash).
He waits a random moment before he strikes and then slides at you, so stopping or backing away does not save you. He is solid while he does it, so you cannot dash through the blow.

The further you get, the harder it gets: the STOPs come sooner, push you back further and hurt more. In the last stretch the wind of the portal blows you back, so crouching or guarding all the way will not get you in.

A dash needs 2.6 seconds to come back. A blocked STOP still hurts a little. If you stay crouched in front of Verity he swings his low claw at you. After every blow he rests for a moment: that is your time to hit him back.
When you lose, the screen tells you which ring killed you and what to do about it. If it is too hard, SET > ASSIST > EASY takes 30% off the damage you take.
The story of chapter 2 goes on after the gauntlet: the Master tears Gojo's blindfold off. You now see Gojo's face without it, still bloody, with his eyes shining blue.
The Master's claw closes on his eyes. Gojo screams and hits the Master again and again, weaker each time, while his eyes get redder and bloodier.
Gojo kicks the Master away. His eyes hang out of their sockets by a few blood vessels, and he pushes them back in. They are red now, with the blue still in them, and his face is covered in blood.
He tries to open his domain, but it fails. The Master pulls him back, tears one eye out and crushes it. Only the blue part is left in his hand, glowing.
All the new pictures are made of the same big pixels as Gojo's own picture, and every moment has its own new sound.
This part is violent and about 40 seconds long. You can still tap to skip from shot to shot.

t: THE STONE IS IN ITS HOLE
n: The purple stone now sits inside the hole of the socket, and the rim of the socket is on top of it. Before, it looked as if it lay outside the gauntlet.
The holes of the six sockets are a little bigger, so there is room for the stone.
The stone is shaded by the rim: darker at the upper left, lit at the lower right, with one white highlight. The metal around it still glows purple and the light still fades out softly.
The sparkles are fewer and calmer.
The purple stone now fades in slowly inside the socket of the middle finger, instead of flashing on.

It is part of the picture now. The stone, its light and its sparkles are made of the same big pixels as the gauntlet, so nothing floats on top of it any more. The metal right next to the stone is lit purple and a soft halo fades out around it. Everything else stays very dark.
The big star-shaped glint is gone. A small twinkle shows on the stone now and then.
The shine sound swells for longer, and its bright ping comes when the stone is fully lit.
The last shot of Chapter 2 is much darker now. The tall figure and his gauntlet are almost black, even in the close-up. You can only just make out their shapes.
Then a purple stone appears in the socket of the middle finger, and it is the only thing that shines. Its light touches the metal right next to it. Everything else stays dark.
The stone is a shaded purple gem now, with a glint and a few sparkles. The glow around it is softer than before.
It is the same picture and the same camera move as before, only very dark.
Chapter 2 has one more scene after WASTED POTENTIAL.
We cut to the Master's dark room. He is still holding Gojo by the neck and he talks to him: your student is gone, nobody can save you. Then, in the middle of a sentence, the whole room flashes white.

The Master is afraid. His eye opens wide, his head is thrown back, he shakes and a red ! shows over him. The telephone on his wrist rings. Its screen only says ??? and the room pulses with every ring. He presses the button and answers.
A deep voice asks: DID YOU GET HIM? The Master says: YES... I HAVE HIM.

Then the camera pushes in from a tall figure standing in the dark to his gauntlet. It has no stones, only six empty sockets. The socket of the middle finger starts to shine purple, and the voice says: GREAT.
Then the card: Chapter 2, TO BE CONTINUED. Tap to skip to the next shot, as before.
The tall figure and the close-up of the gauntlet are new pictures. New sounds: the flash, the frightened heart, the ringing, the answer, the purple shine, and a deep new voice for the ???.

Chapter 2 does not stop at the portal any more. When Yuji dives in, Verity's long arm catches his leg. This part of the story is graphic and bloody. It is only a cutscene: you watch it, you do not play it.

A close-up of the hand closing on the ankle. Then we see the other side of the portal: the Master holds Gojo by the neck and clicks a button on his wrist. The portal starts to close, slowly, with Yuji still halfway in it, screaming for his teacher.
Verity yanks Yuji back out of the portal, swings him over his head by the leg and slams him into the ground. The portal snaps shut.
Verity crouches over him and pounds him, harder and faster. Yuji coughs up blood. The ground cracks and gives way into a crater.
Verity pulls Yuji out of the crater by the collar and drives his arm through his stomach. His organs fall out, a big hole is left in his chest, and he falls.
Verity says: WASTED POTENTIAL. Then the card: Chapter 2, TO BE CONTINUED.
Every close-up is made from the same pictures as the wide shots, just bigger. Tap to skip to the next shot.
New sounds for the blows, the cough, the stab, the organs and the crater.
Chapter 2 has a new goal. You do not win by knocking Verity out any more. You win by getting INTO the portal while you fight him.
The portal stands at the end of the street. A bar at the bottom of the screen shows where you, Verity and the portal are.
Verity is a wall now. You cannot walk through him. DASH forward to slide past his back, or beat him down.
In this fight the dash needs about a second and a half to come back, so use it wisely.

Verity will try to stop you. When you get past him he blinks in front of you and shoots out his long arm. A purple ring and a ! warn you first. Block it, jump over it, duck under it, or dash through him. If you just run into it, it hits you and pushes you back.
When Verity is ready for another STOP, a small diamond shines over his head.
Verity cannot be knocked out for good. When his health runs out he turns into his ball for a few seconds. That is your chance to run for the portal.
When you reach the portal, Yuji jumps in. The arm of Verity is too late. Then comes the card: Chapter 2, TO BE CONTINUED.
Story mode has Chapter 2 now. Finish Chapter 1 and START takes you to it.
Night in the alley. A dark portal opens and Yuji runs for it to save Gojo.
Verity blinks in front of the portal and stops Yuji with his long arm. He says 'Hey, it's me, it's Verity' in his real voice.

Then they fight with their fists. Yuji and Verity trade seven blows, one after the other, and every hit shakes the screen. The last two punches meet in the middle and throw them apart. They are equal.
Then it is your turn. You play Yuji with the same moves you had in the training fight against Gojo, and you fight Verity.
If you lose, REMATCH starts the same fight again. If you win, Verity fades away and Yuji runs for the portal, but it closes just before he gets there.
The chapter ends with TO BE CONTINUED. Tap the screen to skip a cutscene.
Freddy's special moves now cost energy, like the other fighters. The energy bar under his health is blood red now.
PIERCE costs 20%. It checks your energy when you start charging. If you do not have enough, you just do a normal slash and the bar flashes NO CE.
BOILING WATER (the BLUE button) costs 15% when his hand touches the floor. Throwing it is free.
DREAM (the ULTIMATE) costs 67%, like every other ultimate. If you do not have enough, nothing happens and you do not lose the 30 second wait.
Crouching costs 3% now, the same as everyone else.
His normal slashes, the crouch slash, the heavy strike, the block and the dashes are still free.
Hitting the enemy and getting hit fills the bar. It also fills slowly by itself when you wait. In Free Play the energy never runs out, as before.
The DOMAIN button is now called DREAM for Freddy. It is free, and you can use it once every 30 seconds.
The enemy has to be in front of you, close enough (150 steps), alone and standing. If not, it says TOO FAR or CANT and you keep it.
First a music box plays and music notes float to the enemy. The street turns blue and the enemy falls asleep.
Then Freddy follows him into his dream: a scary boiler room. He slashes the enemy four times, then drives his claw right through him.
The damage is REAL. It comes off the enemy's health bar the moment each hit lands: 10, 10, 12, 12 and 36. That is 80 damage.
Then the enemy wakes up in a white flash, back in the street, and he keeps bleeding for 4 seconds (20 more damage). 100 damage in all.
While it plays nobody can move and the round timer stops. If the enemy is knocked out in the dream, the round ends right there.
It works on Gojo, Yuji, Verity and the Cat, but not on small curse spirits.
4 new sounds (a music box, a nightmare swell, a claw scrape and a wake-up) and a new moon icon for the button.

t: FREDDY: HEAVY STRIKE, DASH CANCEL AND THE PIERCE
n: HEAVY STRIKE: land a slash, then keep ATTACK held for a moment. Freddy swings a slow, hard slash. It does 1.6 times the damage and breaks a guard.
DASH CANCEL: press DASH during a slash that has hit and he dashes out of it right away. It says CANCEL!
THE PIERCE (new): press ATTACK and keep holding it for a long time, 1.3 seconds, when no combo is going on. He coils back with his claw and red sparks gather.
Then he drives his claw straight through the enemy: 30 damage, a big knock back, and the enemy bleeds for 4 seconds. Nothing blocks it.
If you let go too early, you just do a normal slash. If you miss, he is open for a moment, like any miss.
Because of this, his slashes now start when you let go of the button (the same way Verity's heavy punch works).
15 new pierce pictures for the charge and the thrust.

t: FREDDY: GUARD BREAK AND CROUCH DASH
n: GUARD BREAK: some blows go through a guard (the Concentrated Fist, the uppercut, and curse moves nothing can block). Before, Freddy's hand caught even these.
Now his guard is broken: he takes the hit and gets a new reaction. The claw arm is knocked up and back, his head snaps, he staggers a step and recovers. It says GUARD BREAK.
Normal blows are still caught as before.
CROUCH DASH: press DASH while crouched. Freddy scuttles low with his claw dragging in front, 50 steps forward or a short back-step if you hold back, and stays crouched afterwards.
It works like his normal dash: free, and the enemy's blows miss him at the start of it.
10 new guard break pictures and 15 new crouch dash pictures, drawn on the same puppet.
Freddy's BLUE button now works. It is called WATER. It is free, because Freddy has no energy bar.
Press 1: he stoops and touches the floor with his claw hand. The floor in front of him turns into water, a puddle spreads and steam rises. It waits for 6 seconds.
Press 2 (the button now says THROW): he scoops the water up and flings it. A ball of hot water flies at the enemy.
The splash does 25 damage. Then the enemy burns for 8 seconds, with flames on him, and loses a little health about every second.
Nothing blocks the water, not even a guard. A hit on Freddy dries the puddle.
New sounds for the splash and for the floor turning to water. New pictures for the touch and the throw.

t: FREDDY GETS HURT AND KNOCKED OUT
n: Freddy now has his own pictures when he is hit. Before, he just stood there and shivered.
4 kinds of hit reaction, 10 pictures each: head snapped back, doubled over, a stagger with the arms flying, and knocked down (he falls on his back, lies there and sits up).
New K.O.: he is thrown back, falls flat, bounces a little and lies there with his claw hand dropping. The game's tumble physics decides how far and how high he flies.
Done on the same puppet as his other pictures, so he looks like himself.
New UPDATE LOG screen (this one). Tap UPDATE LOG on the title screen to open it.
It lists every update with its version number, newest first, in simple words.
A NEW tag shows on the button until you open the log.

t: FREDDY WALKS WITH HIS GUARD UP AND BLOCKS CROUCHED
n: BLOCK WALK: hold BLOCK and walk. Only Freddy's legs move, and his body bounces up a little on every step. His claw arm stays out, ready to catch.
CROUCH BLOCK: crouch and hold BLOCK. His claw goes out low to catch kicks, and he stands completely still.
The crouch block only catches kicks and the uppercut. Punches still fly over his head.
You can now press CROUCH while you hold BLOCK. He goes down and the guard comes back up.

t: FREDDY CREEPS AND RAKES WHILE CROUCHED
n: Freddy can now walk while crouched. He creeps slowly, at about half of his normal speed.
New crouch attack C.RAKE: press ATTACK while crouched for a low claw swipe along the floor and up. You can press it again and again.
A hit still makes him stand up. If you press CROUCH while he creeps, he finishes the step first.

t: EVERY HITBOX IS MEASURED ON THE DRAWING
n: A hitbox is the invisible box the game uses to decide if a hit lands.
New switch: SETTINGS > GAME > SHOW HITBOXES. Blue = bodies, red = the arm or leg that hits, white = where they touch.
Hits now use the real drawings, row by row. A long arm reaches far and a short arm does not.
Custom fighters: your attacks reach as far as you drew them, enemy attacks use the body you drew, and your shots are as big as their drawing.
Big curses are drawn further back so what you see matches how they fight. Their hits land where their drawn arm or claw touches you.
Fighters push each other by their real width. Verity and the Cat no longer stand inside you.
Bug fixed: an enemy could stand close to you and never swing.

t: FREDDY'S BLOCK IS A WHOLE FREDDY
n: The block picture is a complete Freddy now. His body leans and dips towards the blow.
He has a real arm: a shoulder, an elbow that bends and a forearm.
The hand follows the enemy's fist or foot, and the blades close over it.
New pixel-art arm: a red sleeve with green stripes, a brown glove and four blades that open and close.
While he waits, the hand drifts in a small circle (5 pictures).
When the enemy swings, the hand moves to where the hit will land. The blades close on it.

t: FREDDY CAN BLOCK: HE CATCHES THE BLOW
n: Hold BLOCK on the ground and Freddy puts his claw hand out in front of him. The guard is up after a very short moment.
A hit from the front is caught in the air. No damage, no push. It says GRABBED! and the enemy is held for about 0.75 seconds.
He walks slowly while blocking. He cannot slash, dash or jump at the same time.
Two new drawing boxes: HURT plays when you get hit, and KO plays when your health runs out.
You cannot act while the HURT pictures play.
The list of drawing boxes is now two rows of seven.
New BLOCK drawing box. Hold BLOCK and your pictures play. It works like the real block: hits from the front bounce off.
A block raised just before a hit is a PARRY. The enemy is stunned and you get energy.
New TEST button: it saves your fighter and starts free play with it right away.
You walk at a third of your speed while blocking. PARRY TIME is a new stat.

t: CUSTOM FIGHTERS: SHOOT, REPEAT, IF AND DASH
n: SHOOT block: sends a shot out of your fist. It uses your own effect drawings.
REPEAT block plays the blocks inside it again and again.
IF HIT and IF MISS blocks only run when the hit above them landed or missed.
New drawing boxes FRONT DASH and BACK DASH. The DASH button now works for custom fighters.
New drawing boxes CROUCH (going down; getting up plays it backwards) and CROUCH IDLE.
Custom fighters can crouch and walk crouched in free play.
New STATS list: health, walk speed, jump height, energy, damage and more. You can change the numbers.
The list of drawing boxes is now two rows of four.
The block list scrolls and is sorted into groups. Up to 20 blocks per punch.
Blocks that change a hit: KNOCKBACK, STUN, LAUNCH, GUARD BREAK and BLEED.
Blocks for style: SOUND, SHAKE and HIT STOP (a tiny freeze).
Punch settings: SPEED, LUNGE (a step forward), COST (energy) and COOLDOWN.
New VFX (visual effects) block. Put it right under an IMPACT to play an effect when the hit lands.
Pick one of 5 ready effects (spark, burst, fist, ground, shot) or draw your own with up to 5 pictures.
New CODE screen: drag blocks to build each punch. FRAME = which picture, IMPACT = how much damage.
In free play an IMPACT hurts the enemy for exactly that damage when he is in front of you and close enough.
Your blocks are saved with the character.

t: CUSTOM FIGHTERS: NAMED PUNCHES AND THE ATTACK BUTTON
n: Give each of the 4 punches a name (up to 9 letters).
In free play the ATTACK button shows the name of the next punch and plays its pictures. Nothing is hit yet.
New ATTACK box with the 4 punches of the combo (M1 #1 to #4), 5 to 15 pictures each.
ANIM TEMPLATE gives ready-made punches (jab, cross, uppercut, kick).
They are only drawn and saved for now. They do not hit yet.
New JUMP box (up to 15 pictures). The templates have jump pictures too.
A custom fighter can jump in free play. Enemy swings miss while you are high up.
The drawing board shows a gold floor line. Draw the feet so they end on it.
In the game your character now stands on that line.
The 5 templates were moved up one row and the dark ones were made lighter.
New ANIM TEMPLATE button loads a ready-made animation into the box you are drawing: idle (4 pictures) or walking (5 pictures).
5 looks to start from: SORCERER, FIGHTER, HOODED, KNIGHT and ONI.

t: DRAWING THAT WORKS ON A PHONE
n: TRACKPAD: drag a finger to move a crosshair and tap to draw. Your finger never covers the spot.
Auto-zoom, a steady brush that smooths shaky lines, and PERFECT lines (one pixel thick).
BIG and SHRINK: draw on a bigger canvas, then shrink it down to 64 x 64.
All menus look like a Jujutsu manga page now: dark panels, bone-white borders, red details and slanted titles.
New two-line logo and a red seal on the title screen.
After you name a fighter you get a list of drawing boxes: IDLE and WALKING.
A fighter with walking pictures walks in free play.
ZOOM (pinch with two fingers), OFFSET (the pen draws above your finger) and starting pictures to copy: BODY, GOJO, YUJI, VERITY, CAT, FREDDY.
New shapes (box, oval), SELECT with COPY and FLIP, ONION (see the picture before), 32 MODE, IMPORT a picture from your phone, OUTLINE and SHADE.
Up to 15 idle pictures per drawing, with an IDLE PREVIEW that plays them.
Your drawn characters can be picked in free play. They stand still and cannot move yet.

t: CUSTOM MODE: DRAW YOUR OWN CHARACTER
n: New CUSTOM mode (the ART card) with 3 slots. Name your character, then draw it on a 64 x 64 pixel board.
Tools: pen, eraser, fill, colour picker, lines and more. Everything is saved on your device.

t: NO CHAPTER 2 ANYWHERE IN THE GAME
n: The game and the story never say chapter 2 now.
The morning training starts with the card A HAPPY MORNING only. Save slots say CHAPTER 1 COMPLETE or THE MYSTERY: TRAINING DONE.

t: THE FIGHT AGAINST THE MASTER CONTINUES
n: The story goes on after Gojo is thrown into the wall (about 108 seconds in all).
The room goes completely silent and the wind of the portal blows Yuji's hair back. Yuji screams SENSEI NO! and charges at the Master.
Gojo uses Blue to drag Yuji back, then blinks in front of the Master with his Infinity barrier around him.
There is a talk. The Master's claw hits the Infinity barrier, it cracks and breaks, and the Master grabs Gojo by the neck and takes him through the portal.
The chapter ends with the card END OF CHAPTER 1 / THE MYSTERY / TO BE CONTINUED. Tap to skip steps.
Chapter 1 has a name now: THE MYSTERY. It shows on the story card, on a title card in the story, on the end card and on the save slots.
The arm Gojo holds out to stop Yuji is now at shoulder height and looks more natural: a bent elbow, a striped sleeve and an open hand.

t: GOJO'S ARM TO STOP YUJI, REMADE
n: New picture of Gojo reaching out to stop Yuji. The old one looked strange.
Two other pictures with an arm reaching forward were redrawn too, so three in all.
The Master is now Freddy's own picture painted black, with a red eye.
In the close-up Gojo's fist really touches his face and his head is thrown back (it still does not hurt him).
Everybody sits properly at the table and eats. The ramen shop was redrawn too.
Four fixes to the restaurant scene: the close-ups use Gojo's real fight picture, the Master looks better, the people who died stay dead, and everyone sits down properly.

t: THE END OF THE MORNING STORY: A RAMEN SHOP, A DARK PORTAL AND THE MASTER
n: Gojo no longer says that Yuji has his normal form only.
Now Yuji is the one who says he is starving. Then they go to eat.
New last scene (about 42 seconds): the ramen shop, a dark portal and the Master.

t: A HAPPY MORNING: TRAINING ON THE TRACK FIELD
n: New story part after chapter 1. Gojo and Yuji train on a track field. Yuji tries to land a punch, but Gojo's Infinity stops it.
Then there is a fight. You play Yuji with all his normal moves. Gojo (Grade 2) only has block, dash and punches.
A happy ending and a card follow the fight.

t: THE MASTER: A NEW LAST SCENE OF CHAPTER 1
n: After the Cartoon Cat dies, a dark hooded figure with one glowing red eye has been watching the whole fight.
Verity opens a door, walks in, closes it and says Hello Master. Then the chapter ends (about 33 seconds).

t: YUJI'S INHERITENCE DEALS HALF THE DAMAGE
n: INHERITENCE did far too much damage. All of its damage is cut in half (not the Hometown Domain).
Example: the 4-hit Black Flash chain went from 318 damage to 159.

t: NO FIGHTER TURNS INTO GOJO IN AN ABILITY ANIMATION
n: Bug fixed: in some ability animations (like Max Blue and Freddy's FATALITY) the enemy was drawn as Gojo. Every fighter now keeps his own look.

t: THE STORY'S TWO CHAPTERS ARE ONE CHAPTER
n: The story is one chapter now: the alley fight with Verity, the report to the higher-ups, and then the Cartoon Cat part with no card in between.
The old END OF CHAPTER 1 / TO BE CONTINUED card and the CHAPTER 2 title card are gone.

t: YUJI'S HOMETOWN DOMAIN AND GOJO'S SIMPLE DOMAIN
n: New Yuji skill HOMETOWN DOMAIN ($5000): a 10-second domain that slices the enemy with white scissor marks. It works only in INHERITENCE, and you need all of Yuji's other skills first.
The hand sign has your GIF behind Yuji.
New Gojo skill SIMPLE DOMAIN ($600, needs REVERSAL RED): in red mode, RED while crouched makes a cyan circle on the floor. Domain attacks do nothing to him inside it.
New Yuji skill FATALITY ($1000): a 30-second cutscene of eight Black Flashes, with its own version for every enemy.
It works when the enemy has 20% health or less and is close. It costs half of the energy.
The FATAL button now works for Yuji.

t: FREDDY'S DASH AND YUJI'S TWO CROUCH PUNCHES
n: Freddy's DASH button makes him sprint. 15 new running pictures. It is free. Holding forward (or standing still) he runs forward, and holding back he does a short back-step.
Yuji gets two crouch punches, R.JAB and L.UPPR (ATTACK while crouched).
New drawings for Yuji's jump, his jump out of a crouch and his landing into a crouch (15 pictures each).
The jump works exactly as before. Only the pictures are new.

t: YUJI'S ULTIMATE: FOUR BLACK FLASHES IN A ROW
n: New Yuji skill BLACK FLASH ULTIMATE ($1500) on the DOMAIN button: four Black Flashes in a row and a huge last punch.
It costs 67% of the energy and you wait 30 seconds before the next one. The enemy must be close and in front of you.

t: VERITY'S AIR BITE AND FREDDY'S TWO SLASHES
n: New Verity skill AIR BITE ($400): press BLUE in the air and he falls on the enemy to bite him.
Freddy can attack now: R.SLASH with his claw and L.SLASH with his bare hand. Press ATTACK again to chain them.
Freddy can crouch. Tap CROUCH or hold the stick down. 15 pictures going down, and standing up plays them backwards.
It is the stalker's crouch: low and hunched, with the claw out in front.
Springing out of a crouch makes a higher jump, and a jump can end in a crouch landing.
Punches pass over a crouching Freddy. Only kicks hit him.
Freddy's legs are thinner and straighter now, with proper shoes. The dark blobs are gone.

t: FREDDY MOVES HIS WHOLE BODY WHEN HE JUMPS
n: Freddy is now made of parts that move on their own: the head with the hat, the body, both arms with bending elbows, and the legs.
In a jump his body leans, arches and tucks, and his head tips.
The JUMP button works for Freddy: a realistic jump of 40 pictures (squat, push-off, rise, tuck, fall, landing).
Freddy can walk, forward and back. It is a slow, smooth glide of 15 pictures.
His feet never slide on the floor, whatever his speed is.
New fighter in the CURSED SPIRITS group: Freddy Krueger, with his hat, striped sweater and clawed glove, in 16-bit pixel art.
You can play him in free play and in Versus (not as an enemy yet). For now he only stands and breathes.

t: PHYSICS III: LOOSE THINGS, HAIR AND CLOTH, FLYING THINGS
n: Pebbles, paper and leaves lie around the street. Hard hits and landings blow them away.
Hair and clothes move with the wind and with hits.
Bug fixed: the rubble swirl of Max Blue was not drawn in 1.37.

t: PHYSICS II: RAGDOLLS, DEBRIS AND A STREET THAT BREAKS
n: Knocked-out bodies now tumble, bounce on the floor, slide and flop flat like real bodies.
Pieces of debris fly off, and the street can break.

t: PHYSICS I: WEIGHT, MOMENTUM, FALLING AND SOLID BODIES
n: Everyone has a weight. A hit pushes a light fighter far and a heavy one only a little.
Bodies slide with real friction and stop. Walking has a short start and stop.
Bodies are solid: fighters cannot walk through each other.

t: HUNTS: TEN SEARCHES ON A LONG STREET
n: New HUNTS in CHALLENGES: ten searches on a long scrolling street. Clear one to open the next.
Break crates, inspect things and find talismans, clues and hidden curses, then defeat the curse. A map strip shows where you have been.

t: VERITY'S HEAVY PUNCH AND AIR COMBO
n: Verity: hold ATTACK for 0.6 seconds for a slow heavy punch with double damage that breaks a guard. (skill HEAVY PUNCH, $150)
Verity: on his last M1 punch press JUMP to kick the enemy up and keep the combo going in the air. (skill AIR COMBO, $450)
Each fighter needs a different time to break out of a combo.

t: FLOW COMBAT III: HEAVY AND CANCEL FOR EVERYONE
n: Verity and the Cat can use HEAVY (hold ATTACK after a hit) and CANCEL (DASH during a hit) like Gojo and Yuji.
They are skills now: HEAVY STRIKE and DASH CANCEL, in the skill tree and the shop.
New damage cap, so the boosts can never add up to something silly.

t: FLOW COMBAT II: THE FLOW METER AND THE STAGGER BAR
n: FLOW (a purple bar): it fills when you mix your moves, parry and dodge. When it is full you get 6 seconds of 1.25 times the damage.
STAGGER (an orange bar under the enemy's health): hits fill it. When it is full the enemy is stunned and takes 1.4 times the damage.

t: FLOW COMBAT I: HEAVY STRIKES, CANCELS AND THE END OF BUTTON MASHING
n: HEAVY: keep ATTACK held after a hit for a strong finishing hit that breaks a guard.
CANCEL: press DASH during a swing that hit to dash out of it and get some energy back.
Against button mashing: the same swing again hits 20% weaker each time, and a swing that hits nothing leaves you open for a moment.

t: A FASTER GAME, PARRY SLOW MOTION, DODGE ENERGY, PRESSURE AND SPEED BONUS
n: New GAME PACE setting (SETTINGS > GAME): FAST is the new default. TURBO is even faster. The timers still count real seconds.
A perfect PARRY starts a short slow motion, and then you get a free counter attack.
DODGE: a dash just before a hit makes it miss and gives you energy.
PRESSURE: the longer you do not hit the enemy, the shorter his rests become.
SPEED BONUS in RUSH and ROULETTE: clear a wave fast and you get extra money.

t: THE STATE TRACKER AND THE COMBO ESCAPE
n: A small box next to your health bar shows your state: green FREE, or red HIT, DOWN, STUN or HELD.
When it is red, press DASH to get out of the combo and hit back with your last M1.

t: TWO NEW SKILLS, AND YUJI'S INHERITENCE MOVES ARE BOUGHT ONE BY ONE
n: Verity: BLOOD DRAG ($350). CROUCH + BLUE bites the enemy's feet and drags him along the floor, leaving blood behind.
The Cat: GIANT SMASH ($450).
Yuji's INHERITENCE moves are now bought one by one.

t: THE FIVE NEW CURSES ARE REDRAWN
n: Bone Hound, Lantern Wraith, Stitch Doll, Blade Mantis and Shell Crab now have shaded, detailed pictures like the first five curses.

t: FIVE NEW CURSES AND THE ROULETTE
n: Five new curses with their own pictures: Bone Hound, Lantern Wraith, Stitch Doll, Blade Mantis and Shell Crab. Each has a normal and a hard fight, so 10 new challenges.
New ROULETTE challenge.

t: THE SKILLS PAGE IS A SKILL TREE
n: Every fighter's skills are drawn as a tree. Dark = locked, gold = ready to unlock, green = yours.
Tap a skill to read what it does and what it needs, then tap UNLOCK.
New TRAIN tab in SETTINGS for free play with 10 options: what the enemy does, enemy health, your health, your energy, enemy level, who the enemy is, enemy armour, game speed and more.

t: THE OLD BLUE MOVES ARE BACK
n: Yuji's old BLUE moves (Divergent Fist, Rush Fist, Sweep, Concentrated Fist, Spin Elbow, Uppercut) are back with their skills and prices.
CURSED TECHNIQUE is only in INHERITENCE now. It comes with INHERITENCE, so it is not sold separately.

t: CURSED TECHNIQUE IS YUJI'S BLUE MOVE
n: Yuji's CURSED TECHNIQUE moved to the BLUE button and replaced his old BLUE moves. (This was changed back in 1.23.)

New Yuji skill CURSED TECHNIQUE ($1200) on his DOMAIN button. It does four different things depending on what he is doing: PIERCING BLOOD (standing), SHRINE (crouched), GRAB + CLEAVE (walking forward) and SIMPLE DOMAIN (in the air).
The hair of INHERITENCE was a huge crown. Now it is Yuji's own hair with only a little more spike, all swept back.
New Yuji skill INHERITENCE ($2000, needs BLACK FLASH). In THE ZONE tap MODE twice to switch it on.
Tall spiky hair, a red-black aura and a bar with the seconds left.
It lasts 10 seconds. After that he loses half of his health, and no mode works until the next round.

t: EVERYTHING EXCEPT BLOCK, DASH AND PUNCHES COSTS CURSED ENERGY
n: Crouching now costs 3% of the energy. Switching on the cursed energy mode costs 10%, and so does red mode.
BLOCK, DASH and the punches stay free.
The talking ball's mouth now follows your recording: wide on the loud words, closed in the pauses.
The Cat's buttons were stretched over the whole screen. Fixed: they look like everyone else's now.

t: VERITY'S BALL CAN TALK, AND THE CAT'S GIANT THROWS HIM
n: In ball mode the ATTACK button says TALK. Verity says Hey, it's me, it's Verity (your recording) and the enemy cannot act for 2.5 seconds.
The huge Cat can grab you, lift you out of the screen and throw you onto the enemy.

t: THREE DRAWN BLACK FLASH ANIMATIONS AND REAL BLACK-AND-RED SPARKS
n: In THE ZONE, Yuji's BLACK FLASH depends on what he is doing: standing = a punch, in the air = a kick to the head, crouched = a blow to the stomach.
Each one has its own newly drawn animation and black-and-red sparks.
BATTLES now shows Gojo, Yuji, Verity and the Cartoon Cat. Every move of every fighter is free in free play.
Yuji, Verity and the Cat practise against a punching bag that never ends: no timer, you cannot lose and the energy never runs out.

t: YUJI'S THIRD MODE, THE ZONE, AND BLACK FLASH
n: THE ZONE ($600): a red and black aura, and his M1 becomes a 4-hit chain: high kick, spin kick, punch and spin punch.
BLACK FLASH ($800): in the Zone, BLUE becomes a punch with double damage that cannot be blocked and sends the enemy flying.

t: MADE FOR PHONES, AND EVERY FIGHTER BUYS HIS MOVES
n: Yuji, Verity and the Cat buy their moves in the SKILLS shop, like Gojo.
New settings: vibration, a pause button, button size, fade and left-handed layout, frame rate and battery saver, assist options (a wider parry, easy mode) and a SAVE BACKUP code.
Everything is faster: walking, jumping, the dash, and punches. Hit reactions are about 30% shorter and enemies rest less.
A round lasts 45 seconds (it was 60). The intro and the K.O. screen are shorter, and the REMATCH button glows after a defeat.
New hit feel: a tiny freeze when you hit, screen shake, sparks, a combo counter and an energy meter.
New RUSH challenge with 5 waves.
You start as Gojo with only walking, jumping and punches. Every other move is a skill you buy with money on the new SKILLS page.
Yuji, Verity and the Cartoon Cat must be bought too.
New CHALLENGES mode: beat five curses to earn money. Each one has three moves of its own.
Money and skills are saved on your device.

h: BEFORE V1.00: THE OLD VERSION NUMBERS

t: WI-FI ROOMS: CHARACTER SELECT AND AN EXACT PING
n: When two phones are in a room, both open a CHOOSE YOUR SORCERER screen. (Android app only)
The room shows an exact ping. Ping = how long the other phone takes to answer, in thousandths of a second.
New mode for phones on the same Wi-Fi. Create a room with a name, or browse the rooms of other phones and join one. (Android app only)
Yuji in cursed energy mode: press BLUE in the air. He spins and drives an elbow into the enemy, who falls.
Gojo now uses his other hand and the animation has 20 different pictures.

t: GOJO TAKES THE BLINDFOLD OFF HIMSELF
n: The full-screen GIF is gone. The real Gojo in the fight takes the blindfold off.
While the domain lasts the enemy cannot do anything, and nothing of his can hurt you.
Yuji in cursed energy mode: crouch and press BLUE for an UPPERCUT, then a FACE KICK.
Hold FORWARD and press BLUE: a super fast Divergent Fist while Yuji runs.

t: YUJI'S CURSED ENERGY MODE, CONCENTRATED FIST AND SWEEP
n: The MODE button works for Yuji now. New moves: CONCENTRATED FIST and a SWEEP kick.

t: BLOCK FOR YUJI AND THE CAT
n: The BLOCK button works for Yuji and the Cartoon Cat now.
A punch full of cursed energy, with a second hit in the enemy's stomach as the fist is pulled back.

t: A NEW FACE FOR THE SMALL GOJO
n: His head is drawn from the side now, so the face looks right while the blindfold is down.

t: THE BLINDFOLD GIF KEEPS ITS BACKGROUND
n: The close-up GIF is only pixelated now. Its background stays.

t: THE BLINDFOLD CLOSE-UP IS THE REAL GIF
n: The hand-drawn faces were replaced by your GIF.
Redrawn from the angle of the anime shot.

t: THE BLINDFOLD AND A NEW FACE CLOSE-UP
n: New close-up: Gojo pulls his blindfold down before the Domain Expansion.

t: THE END OF THE CARTOON CAT
n: In the story fight, when the Cat's health runs out he stays on his feet, dizzy. Then a cutscene of about 30 seconds ends his story.

t: TWO FIXES FOR THE CAT'S ULTIMATE
n: You can no longer start a normal swing in the same moment as the ULTIMATE.
The enemy Cat's ULTIMATE stops if he is hit, stunned or grabbed before his glove lands.
ULTIMATE: his glove shoots out and takes the enemy by the neck. It costs 67% of the energy and you wait 30 seconds for the next one.
The Cat has his own FATALITY.
An ownership notice was added to the APK.

t: THE CARTOON CAT IS A FIGHTER
n: The Cartoon Cat can be picked in the CURSED SPIRITS section, as your fighter or as the enemy.
His M1 is a 4-hit combo (30 damage in all). His energy bar is pink.

t: THE CARTOON CAT IN THE STORY
n: New opening for the Cat part of the story: a title card, the corridor with the big door, and the grounds of Jujutsu High at night.

t: GOJO IS SILENT IN FRONT OF THE DOORS
n: The line about big doors and big egos is gone. A better Gojo in the higher-ups' room.

t: CHAPTER 1 ENDS WITH THE REPORT TO THE HIGHER-UPS
n: After the Reversal Red deletes Verity a new cutscene of about 76 seconds follows.
Before, a hit landed when the two centres were closer than a fixed number. Now it depends on the real size of each fighter's arm, leg and body.

t: TEN HIT REACTIONS FOR YUJI AND VERITY
n: Yuji and Verity have 10 hit reactions like Gojo (head snap, doubled over, stagger, spin, knocked flat and more).
Gojo's FATALITY works on Verity.
Gojo's and Verity's FATALITY now work on Yuji, both ways.

t: YUJI'S CROUCH AND DASHES, AND VERITY'S DOUBLE JUMP
n: Yuji can crouch and dash. His jump kick is weaker (20 damage in all).
Verity can jump twice.
Four hits: right hook, left hook, knee and a jump kick.
Yuji is built like Gojo now: a slim body and arms hanging at his sides.
Yuji is a new choosable fighter next to Gojo, as your fighter and as the enemy.
Verity has his own FATALITY with the same rules as Gojo's.
Gojo got a run cycle.
Verity's own move on the DOMAIN button: he grabs the other fighter by the throat and stuns him with fear. It costs 67% of the energy.

t: PLAYABLE VERITY, THE CURSED SPIRITS SECTION AND THE BALL
n: Verity can be played. The Versus screen has two sections now: SORCERERS and CURSED SPIRITS.
Verity can turn into a ball.
The words that explained what was happening (TOO EARLY!, DELETED and more) are gone from the story cutscenes.

t: A FAILED RED, THE EXTRA FIGHTS, AND GOJO'S DEATH
n: A failed Red no longer restarts the story. Gojo still fires, but Verity dodges.
Extra fights and a scene where Gojo can die.
The ambush was redone with a camera push-in on Gojo's face. The red ending is a quick-time event.
When Verity's health runs out he does not fall. A red dusk comes over the alley and Gojo ends the fight with Reversal Red.
Verity is a real fighter in the alley fight. Every move has its own 15-picture animation.
STORY MODE opens CHOOSE A SAVE with three slots. The first cutscene starts in a dark alley.

t: MODE SCREEN AND A FATALITY PRICE
n: TAP TO START opens a CHOOSE A MODE screen with BATTLES and STORY MODE.
FATALITY now costs energy.
A cyan energy bar under Gojo's health bar in Versus mode. Every energy move takes some of it.
The text in a fight was blurry. It is sharp now.

t: THE WIND-UP PUNCH AND THE ENEMY'S FATALITY
n: Gojo's FATALITY cutscene opens with a wind-up punch.
The enemy can use a FATALITY on you too.
New FATAL button. It works when the enemy has 20% health or less and is close. A cutscene finishes him.
When a fighter dies the round ends at once and the other fighter gets the point.
Fight an enemy Gojo (inverted colours) in best-of-3 rounds. Six grades from GRADE 4 up to SPECIAL GRADE. Beating a grade opens the next.
New DOMAIN button. Gojo does the hand sign, everyone freezes and the Infinite Void plays.

t: LANES, A LONGER MAX BLUE AND THE PURPLE ORB
n: The street has an upper and a lower lane for the people who walk past.
Max Blue lasts 1 second longer. Fire RED into it and the two fuse into a purple orb.
The five people on the street look better and they make sounds.
Five ordinary people walk across the street. They run away when Gojo fights, and they can be hit.
Title screen with Gojo lifting his blindfold. A night street with a zebra crossing.
Walk, jump, a double jump (teleport up), crouch, a 4-hit combo, dash and block.
Lapse Blue, Max Blue, cursed energy mode, red mode and Reversal Red, Hollow Purple.
Hit reactions, a training dummy, an attacking dummy and a blocking dummy.
Sound made by the game itself and a settings screen.
